article.story: BALTIMORE -- — DJ Armstrong had 12 points in UMBC's 71-57 win over Delaware State on Saturday. Armstrong added eight rebounds for the Retrievers (5-2). Daylon Dickerson scored 12 points while going 5 of 7 from the field and added five rebounds. Jah'likai King shot 5 for 11 to finish with 11 points. The Hornets (2-7) were led by Ponce James, who recorded 19 points. Delaware State also got 11 points from Corey Perkins. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
